en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Watch a documentary on bugs
Watch a documentary on adventurers
Watch a documentary on magic tricks
Haha, I bet Gonta would love this!

By the way, about Gonta?
His talent is really incredible.

I guess, everyone's talents are really
cool, but his is by far the most unique.
...I wonder what my talent is like.

It would be pretty embarrassing if it turned
out to be something lame, after all this buildup.
I really admire these people...

Visiting all those places and meeting new
people... I would love to spend my life like that.

Hey, maybe my talent is
"Ultimate Explorer"!

That would be so cool...
But things don't always work out like that.
No thanks, I'll pass.

These things give
away all the tricks!

I wouldn't want to take
the wonder out of it...

No point in ruining all the
fun for yourself, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Rantaro looks deep in thought...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Rantaro's inner thoughts...?
